name: frequency
label: Frequency
helpText: One-time or recurring interval for cycle generation.

name: cycleDurationDays
label: Cycle Duration (Days)
helpText: Number of days each cycle remains open (1–60 days). Must be shorter than the period.

name: recurrenceEndDate
label: Recurrence End Date
helpText: Date after which no new cycle is created. Leave blank for continuous cycles.
